title: devalue before 5.9.3 allows malformed null-prototype object keys to bypass parse's __proto__ rejection through…
description: A vulnerability in devalue versions before 5.9.3 allows attackers to bypass the __proto__ property rejection during parsing by using malformed null-prototype object keys through property-key coercion. This is an incomplete fix related to a previous advisory (GHSA-mwv9-gp5h-frr4). Although attackers can craft payloads that produce objects with a __proto__ own property, this alone does not lead to prototype pollution.
